$comment: Controls the 'Flagship models' table in the READMEs and the site's default view.
The full dataset is unaffected — this is presentation only.
`providers` is ordered; each entry lists the model-name prefixes that belong to
that provider's own line-up. Prefixes matter because most hosts resell each other's
models: without them, `deepseek-v4-pro` shows up under Qwen and `glm-5-2` under Mistral,
which is technically true (that is who bills you) but useless as a flagship table.
`exclude_patterns` drops variant spellings of a model already in the table —
preview channels, per-mode splits, and modality-specific endpoints.
